title: Lena and the Oath
premise: Petra Vasquez has spent her life guarding the Hollow Gate in a valley where magic cannot enter, believing the oath her grandmother swore keeps everyone safe. When a dying courier named Ivo presses a blood-marked map into Petra's hands and names them the gate's true heir, Petra learns the valley's peace was purchased with a soul—Petra's own, sold before birth to the court beneath the mountain. Hunted by the mountain's collectors and betrayed by the mentor who enforced the oath, Petra must cross into the magic-soaked lands beyond, gather three unlikely allies, and steal their soul back from the Undercourt before the winter solstice seals the bargain forever. In the end, Petra rewrites the oath itself: rather than destroy the gate or flee through it, they bind the court's power to the valley's silence, freeing every sold soul at the cost of never being able to return home unseen.
about_author: Sebastian Hartwell is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing border-town folklore across three continents. They write fantasy about people trapped by promises older than themselves.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Establishes daily life tending the Hollow Gate: checking its seals, trading with caravans that never linger, obeying grandmother Maren's iron rules. Petra secretly sketches maps of roads they've never walked. Emotional beat: restless contentment on the edge of something forbidden.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Treeline
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. During a storm, Petra finds Ivo bleeding out against the boundary stones, magic visibly burning him because he crossed too far in. He presses a blood-marked map into Petra's hands and whispers 'the heir comes home.' Emotional beat: dread replacing curiosity as the impossible becomes real.

chapters.title: What Grandmother Swore
chapters.summary: Maren's POV, past-tense interwoven with present. Confronted, Maren confesses the family bargain: generations of keepers bought the valley's immunity by pledging an unborn child's soul to the Undercourt—and this generation, it is Petra. Emotional beat: love revealed as a cage.

chapters.title: The Collectors Arrive
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Grey-robed collectors cross the gate without harm—the only beings immune to the valley's null—and demand the debt be honored at solstice. Maren resists and is struck down, not killed but hollowed, her memories siphoned. Emotional beat: grief fused with fury.

chapters.title: Leaving by Night
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. With the map, a stolen horse, and Maren's seal-ring, Petra slips through the Hollow Gate for the first time. Magic floods in like light after blindness—overwhelming, addictive, dangerous. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration inseparable.

chapters.title: The Road of Small Magics
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The outer world runs on petty enchantments: luck-coins, truth-knots, weather-sellers. Petra learns how visible they are—an outsider with no magic-scent draws every eye. First encounter with bounty notices bearing their own face. Emotional beat: paranoia sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Thief Who Owes a Debt
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. A charming soul-broker's ex-thief, Sable recognizes the map's markings as Undercourt script she once stole for. She offers passage in exchange for Petra stealing back her brother's sold soul too. Emotional beat: wary alliance between two liars.

chapters.title: Ashmarket
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. A bazaar where memories are currency. To learn the solstice ritual's location, Petra sells a cherished memory of Maren teaching them the gate-seals—a price that will matter later. Emotional beat: the theme made literal; survival always costs something irreplaceable.

chapters.title: The Knight Without a Court
chapters.summary: Dain's POV. A disgraced justiciar who enforced oaths for twenty years finds his warrant voided when the Undercourt buys his own judge. He joins Petra not from kindness but because justice outside the law is the only kind left to him. Emotional beat: bitter idealism finding a cause.

chapters.title: Three Names on a Map
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The party deciphers the map: the Undercourt sits beneath Mount Ceren, reachable only via the Drowned Stair during the dark of the moon. A collector ambush forces them off-road into the Weeping Woods. Emotional beat: the team becoming a unit under fire.

chapters.title: The Weeping Woods
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Trees that remember everyone who died beneath them; the forest shows each traveler their worst betrayal. Petra sees Maren's hollowed eyes; Sable sees herself selling Petra out. Emotional beat: loyalty tested by the fear of inevitable treachery.

chapters.title: The Tollhouse of Whispers
chapters.summary: Dain's POV. A checkpoint run by a creature that accepts confessions as toll. Dain confesses the innocent man he condemned to keep his post; the tollkeeper marks him 'paid.' Petra refuses to confess anything, lying their way through. Emotional beat: two philosophies of guilt collide.

chapters.title: Letters Never Sent
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Resting in an abandoned waystation, Petra writes to Maren knowing it can't be delivered, and finally reads Ivo's map margins fully—he was the previous intended heir who fled, and his guilt drove him back to die passing the burden on. Emotional beat: compassion for the coward he was.

chapters.title: The Broker's Bargain
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. Sable's old employer offers to hand Petra to the collectors in exchange for erasing her debts. She stalls, then warns the group—but Petra overheard the initial offer. Trust fractures precisely when unity matters most. Emotional beat: loyalty vs. truth at knife-point.

chapters.title: The Drowned Stair
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Descent beneath Mount Ceren through flooded steps lit by drowned souls' last thoughts. The stolen memory of Maren surfaces here—the missing seal-words Petra sold come back as a ghostly echo, showing what was lost can echo but not return. Emotional beat: mourning while moving forward.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The Undercourt in full splendor: shelves of bottled souls, judges wearing faces of the dead. Petra sees their own soul in a jar labeled with their true name, and meets the creditor—a patient, courteous entity who genuinely believes the bargain is fair. Emotional beat: horror dressed as civility.

chapters.title: The Trial of Debts
chapters.summary: Dain's POV. Petra invokes an ancient right: any contract may be contested by trial. Dain argues the case; the court counters by producing Maren's original oath, read aloud in her own hollowed voice summoned as witness. Emotional beat: justice outside the law, argued inside the enemy's hall.

chapters.title: Sable's Choice
chapters.summary: Sable's POV. During the trial's chaos, Sable is offered her brother's soul free if she betrays Petra mid-escape. She takes the deal—then shatters the jar instead, freeing her brother into dissolution rather than letting the court win. Emotional beat: sacrifice proving loyalty truer than any confession.

chapters.title: The Solstice Gate
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Climax. Escaping with their own jar as the court collapses into pursuit, Petra reaches the Hollow Gate at solstice midnight with collectors closing in. Instead of fleeing through, Petra uses the recovered seal-words—not to lock the gate, but to turn the valley's null-magic inward upon the court's claim, unmaking every soul-debt it holds. Emotional beat: everything staked on one spoken line.

chapters.title: What the Silence Costs
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The debts break; the collectors crumble; the court goes dark. But the binding requires a living anchor: Petra must remain at the gate, half-in and half-out, able to leave but never again unnoticed—forever visible to both worlds. Maren wakes, remembering nothing of her sacrifice, only pride. Emotional beat: victory with a permanent scar.

chapters.title: The Keeper's New Oath
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. The valley opens cautiously to the outer world under new terms Petra drafts themselves—no souls traded, no one invisible again. Sable departs to find what remains of freed souls; Dain stays as the valley's first honest law. Emotional beat: quiet rebuilding, chosen bonds over inherited ones.

chapters.title: Lena and the Oath
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, years later. A child asks why the keeper stands at the gate every dusk. Petra tells the story plainly—including their own lies and losses—and teaches the child the seal-words, no longer a debt but a gift freely given. On the horizon, the mountain stays dark. Emotional beat: peace earned, legacy rewritten.
